name: Valentine Payen-Wicaksono
bio: Valentine Payen-Wicaksono is an actress and director, known for Online Billie (2019), Frangipani Rising (2020) and The Ruthless (2019).

credits.title: Satan's Slaves 3: Origin
credits.overview: A prequel tracing a demonic pact to its origins, beginning with an outbreak of mass hysteria in 16th-century Strasbourg, Holy Roman Empire, then moving to a haunted lighthouse on Java's southern coast in the 17th century.

credits.title: Life of Time
credits.overview: A grieving father desperately attempts to redeem himself by talking a young woman out of taking her life.

credits.title: Midnight in Bali
credits.overview: Other than her hugely popular shows at one of Bali’s favourite gay bars, life isn’t exactly going to plan for trans performer Bulan. After meeting aspiring filmmaker Lily, however, Bulan starts to address her pain and anger. The result is both shocking and cathartic.

credits.title: Samsara
credits.overview: Darta, a man from an impoverished family, is rejected by the wealthy parents of the woman he loves. Desperate, he strikes a bargain with the Monkey King, performing a dark ritual to gain wealth. However, in doing so, he accidentally curses his wife and child to a life of suffering. credits.overview: Nyoman, our hero, is the loneliest person he knows and has given up on the idea of ever finding love. credits.overview: Giorgio, an unruled Italian writer, has found a second home in Bali where he leads a relaxed but somehow purposeless life. credits.title: Online Billie
credits.overview: The story of a wannabe actor who falls in love with a camgirl.

credits.title: Brigitte Moreau
credits.overview: Brigitte Moreau, day dreams of French icons of 60s Paris. Her plan is to write a book of short stories detailing of how she inspired Jean-Luc Godard and strolled around with Jacques Dutronc, however all this might just be might just be the distraction Brigitte is after.

credits.title: The Ruthless
credits.overview: Milan, Italy, 1967. Santo Russo, a boy of Calabrian origin, arrives north with his parents and younger brother to find better living conditions. credits.title: Silence
credits.overview: Around a street corner, Hervé comes face to face with the life he was forced to abandon.

credits.title: Message Man
credits.overview: A retired assassin's past catches up with him and his brutality surfaces as he goes on a final killing spree to make things right.

credits.title: Adele
credits.overview: A young French girl makes a new friend in Bali who takes her to see the sights. She reveals the real reason she traveled to the Indonesian island was to find her father. An improvised film shot over 24 hours.

credits.title: Made in Bali
credits.overview: A young American citizen (played by Mike Lewis) comes to Bali and hires a guide (played by Slamet Raharadjo).  All day they toured the beautiful places in Bali.  They have dinner together to unwind.  Therein lies the surprise.  A touching dramatic story.  Prepare tissue because the story really touches the heart.
